whoMayAvail: Student-citizens of Calamba City

clientSteps.action: Complete the Online Pre-Registration.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Enroll the registered student in the system.

clientSteps.action: Pick up the Registration Form from the Registrar's Office.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Print and release the Registration Form.

sources.name: City College of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Enrollment for Irregular and Transferee Students
plainLanguageName: Enroll as an Irregular or Transferee Student
description: Processes enrollment for irregular students (those not following a standard study plan) and transferees from other schools, including evaluation of previously earned academic units.
officeDivision: City College of Calamba — Office of the College Registrar
whoMayAvail: Student-citizens of Calamba City

clientSteps.action: Complete the Online Pre-Registration, then go to the Office of the Director for subject evaluation and study load assignment.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Submit the list of registered students to the Director's Office, evaluate the student's units, and assign a study load.

clientSteps.action: Claim the Registration Form.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Encode the study load and print the Registration Form.

sources.name: City College of Calamba Citizen's Charter 2025

service: Pre-Registration for Entering Freshmen and Transferees

description: Registers incoming freshmen and transferees at CCC before the enrollment period, evaluates their submitted documents, and assigns them a student ID number and enrollment stub.
officeDivision: City College of Calamba — Office of the College Registrar
whoMayAvail: Student-citizens of Calamba City

clientSteps.action: Complete the online pre-registration via the CCC Registrar's Facebook page to receive a schedule for document submission.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Provide a schedule for document submission.

clientSteps.action: Submit all required documents on the assigned date to receive a student ID number and enrollment stub.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Receive and review all submitted documents.

description: Issues an official copy of a student's grade report for a specific semester or school year at the City College of Calamba.
officeDivision: City College of Calamba — Office of the College Registrar
whoMayAvail: Students of the City College of Calamba

clientSteps.action: Fill out the request form and pay the required fee at the Cashier's Office.
Present the Request Form and Official Receipt to the Registrar's Office.
Claim the Copy of Grades on the scheduled release date.

notes: Copy of Grades will be released within seven (7) working days per the CCC Registrar's Manual of Operation.

Claim the certificate on the scheduled release date.

whoMayAvail: Students of the City College of Calamba

clientSteps.agencyAction: Review the Dropping Form. If approved: student proceeds to Cashier. If disapproved: student is referred to the Dean for consultation.

whoMayAvail: Students of the City College of Calamba

clientSteps.agencyAction: Provide the Leave of Absence Form.

clientSteps.action: Pay the required fee at the Cashier's Office.
Submit the completed forms.

Submit the completed form and wait for a copy.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Accept and file the clearance form.

description: Allows students to formally petition the college to open a subject that is not yet scheduled or has insufficient enrollment numbers. The Dean approves or denies the petition.

whoMayAvail: Students of the City College of Calamba

clientSteps.action: Get a Petition Form from the Registrar's Office.
Fill out, sign, and submit the Petition Form.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Accept and file the form. If approved: the subject will be offered. If disapproved: student is referred to the Dean for consultation.

plainLanguageName: Request a Replacement Copy of a Registration Form, Comp Card, or Diploma

whoMayAvail: Students of the City College of Calamba

clientSteps.action: Fill out the request form and pay the required fee at the Cashier's Office.
Present the Request Form and Official Receipt, then claim the document.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Process and release the requested document.
clientSteps.processing_time: 10 minutes (Registration Form & Comp Card); 14 working days (Diploma)

processingTime: 15 minutes for Registration Form & Comp Card; 14 working days for Diploma
notes: Replacement diploma will be ready within fourteen (14) working days as it is sent to a printing press.

description: Processes a formal request from a teacher or student to review and potentially change a submitted grade at the City College of Calamba. The request undergoes review by the Academic Personnel Council.
officeDivision: City College of Calamba — Office of the College Registrar
whoMayAvail: Teachers and students of the City College of Calamba

detailedRequirements.requirement: Letter requesting a change of grade
Supporting Documents justifying the grade change

clientSteps.action: Submit the letter and supporting documents within one (1) month after grades were submitted.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Review the supporting documents and, if necessary, request an audience with the Academic Personnel Council.
clientSteps.processing_time: 5 minutes (initial review; deliberation takes up to 1 month)

clientSteps.action: Receive a copy of the resolution.
clientSteps.agencyAction: Release the Resolution to the concerned teacher and/or student.

processingTime: 10 minutes (deliberation by the Academic Personnel Council may take one month or more)
notes: The Academic Personnel Council deliberation may take one (1) month or longer.
